reference_summary: ZX-114, an oral JAK1 inhibitor, was tested in a randomized double-blind placebo-controlled phase 2 trial of 240 rheumatoid arthritis patients with inadequate methotrexate response. At 50 mg once daily for 12 weeks, 62% of treated patients reached ACR20 versus 28% on placebo (p < 0.001). ZX-114 significantly improves disease activity.
